from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def mk(status="captured", amount="100.00", refunded="0.00"):
    return Payment("pay_1","inv_1",Decimal(amount),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0,refunded_amount=Decimal(refunded))

# zero
try:
    refund_shipping(mk(), Decimal("0.00"), T0); print("FAIL zero")
except BillingError as e: print("zero ->", e.code)
# negative
try:
    refund_shipping(mk(), Decimal("-1.00"), T0); print("FAIL neg")
except BillingError as e: print("neg ->", e.code)
# over-refund
try:
    refund_shipping(mk(), Decimal("100.01"), T0); print("FAIL over")
except BillingError as e: print("over ->", e.code)
# non-captured
for st in ("authorized","voided","refunded"):
    try:
        refund_shipping(mk(status=st), Decimal("1.00"), T0); print("FAIL", st)
    except BillingError as e: print(st, "->", e.code)
# full refund sets status
p = mk()
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0)
print("full:", p.refunded_amount, p.status)
